sections.title: The Arabian Nights
decision: Volunteers to marry Schahriar and arranges the dawn request with Dinarzade.
otherAccounts: Tells the sequence to Schahriar, beginning with the merchant.

sections.title: The Story of the Merchant and the Genius
decision: Postpones the execution to hear the continuation.

sections.title: The Story of the First Old Man and of the Hind
decision: Sets terms for restoring the boy and reverses the spell.
otherAccounts: Tells a story whose content Scheherazade withholds.

sections.title: The Story of the Second Old Man, and of the Two Black Dogs
decision: Rescues her husband and transforms his brothers.

sections.title: The Story of the Fisherman
decision: Challenges the genius to prove he fitted in the vessel, then shuts it.
otherAccounts: Recounts his captivity and successive vows to the fisherman.

sections.title: The Story of the Greek King and the Physician Douban
decision: Designs a treatment delivered through a polo club.

sections.title: The Story of the Husband and the Parrot
decision: Stages an artificial storm to discredit the parrot’s report.

sections.title: The Story of the Vizir Who Was Punished

cast.label: Girl who speaks to the fish
Man who speaks to the fish
Young king of the Black Isles

decision: Goes alone to investigate the enchanted lake.

sections.title: The Story of the Young King of the Black Isles
decision: Transforms the city and its inhabitants.
headedTeller: Young king of the Black Isles

sections.title: The Story of the Three Calenders, Sons of Kings, and of Five Ladies of Bagdad
decision: Sets the terms of the porter’s stay and demands accounts when guests break them.
otherAccounts: Explains his arrival when Zobeida requires the guests to account for themselves.

sections.title: The Story of the First Calender, Son of a King

cast.label: First Calender's cousin (the woman in the tomb)

decision: Lets the condemned prince go and tells him to leave the kingdom.

sections.title: The Story of the Second Calendar, Son of a King

cast.label: Ruler hostile to the Second Calender

decision: Refuses to kill the prince when the genius demands it.
otherAccounts: Recounts her captivity to the Second Calender.

sections.title: The Story of the Envious Man and of Him Who Was Envied

cast.label: Deceased vizir of the envied man's story
Ship captain who protects the ape
Young enslaved attendant at the ape's supper

decision: Identifies the prince beneath the enchantment and uses magic to restore him.

sections.title: The Story of the Third Calendar, Son of a King

cast.label: One speaking princess among the forty
Old man at the ten men's castle
Ten enslaved men with the merchant

decision: Opens the forbidden door despite the princesses’ warning.
otherAccounts: Recounts the prophecy and why he is hidden.

sections.title: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad the Sailor
decision: Invites Hindbad to hear how he acquired his wealth.

sections.title: First Voyage
decision: Persuades the captain to hear his account and recognize him.

sections.title: Second Voyage

cast.label: Merchant who retrieves Sindbad from the diamond valley

decision: Ties himself to the roc to escape the island.

sections.title: Third Voyage

cast.label: Captain of the third voyage (also of the second)

decision: Proposes building rafts and attacking the giant before escaping.

sections.title: Fourth Voyage

cast.label: Woman brought into the burial cave
Man brought into the burial cave

decision: Uses the burial cave’s opening to escape.

sections.title: Fifth Voyage

cast.label: Man who directs Sindbad to gather coconuts

decision: Uses wine to escape the Old Man of the Sea.

sections.title: Sixth Voyage
decision: Builds a raft and follows the underground river.

sections.title: Seventh and Last Voyage
decision: Frees Sindbad after he reveals the elephants’ burial ground.

sections.title: The Little Hunchback
decision: Proposes moving the hunchback’s body into the purveyor’s house.
otherAccounts: Relates what he knows of the case to the Sultan.

sections.title: The Story of the Barber's Fifth Brother

cast.label: Lame young man in the tailor’s account

decision: Lures Alnaschar to a house where he is attacked.
otherAccounts: Recounts her earlier life and how she came to the house.

sections.title: The Story of the Barber's Sixth Brother
decision: Plays along with the Barmecide’s imaginary meal.
otherAccounts: Recounts the hunchback episode and the barber’s intervention in the surrounding narrative.

sections.title: The Adventures of Prince Camaralzaman and the Princess Badoura

cast.label: Woman who rides in Badoura’s litter

decision: Disguises herself as Camaralzaman and continues the journey.
otherAccounts: Tells Marzavan what happened and why she is imprisoned.
Tells Haiatelnefous her history and reveals her disguise.
Recounts her adventures to Camaralzaman at their reunion.
Explains her conduct to King Armanos before yielding the throne.
Tells the King of China his history after revealing his identity.

sections.title: Noureddin and the Fair Persian

cast.label: Slave dealer who brings the Fair Persian

decision: Proposes that Noureddin sell her when his resources run out.

sections.title: Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp

cast.label: Two enslaved attendants in lamp exchange

decision: Carries out the plan to drug the magician.

sections.title: The Adventures of Haroun-al-Raschid, Caliph of Bagdad
decision: Summons the men whose conduct he has observed.
otherAccounts: Recalls the planned excursion to hear complaints.

sections.title: The Story of the Blind Baba-Abdalla
decision: Insists the dervish apply the ointment to his second eye.

sections.title: The Story of Sidi-Nouman
decision: Takes Sidi-Nouman to her daughter to undo his enchantment.

sections.title: The Story of Ali Colia, Merchant of Bagdad

cast.label: Two olive experts at the hearing

decision: Tests the merchant’s account by seeking expert knowledge about olives.

sections.title: The Enchanted Horse

cast.label: Chief eunuch of the Princess of Bengal

decision: Feigns distress to forestall marriage to the Sultan of Cashmere.
otherAccounts: Recounts the festival and his flight to the Princess of Bengal.

sections.title: The Story of Two Sisters Who Were Jealous of Their Younger Sister
decision: Blocks out the voices and obtains the Talking Bird after her brothers fail.
otherAccounts: Explains to her brothers how she broke the spell.
Reveals what happened to the Sultana’s children.
